content: A tlǝkhdu Yukhan dadak para ud ad lav Yazhigǝl
Auna ɗule a farsud kwar lav zǝɗan ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ Yasu Kristu, Zǝr Yazhigǝl.
A farsud ndǝkve a vindzgud ǝn kaɗkaɗ Ishay tlayang kwarne,

content.text: “Da ɓǝla ɓǝla ka dǝ zǝr ɓǝlar, sadaghin ǝn tǝvuk tsǝkh,
“Udanen ǝn kwar lav dǝ ndzǝɗ ǝn tǝghal kwarne,

content: Ka mǝdlawala Yukhan dadak para ud ǝn tǝghal, ǝn kwardu lav kwarne pǝla udakh ad ghǝr, paratǝralud, ɓisatǝrna Yazhigǝl tsugun ad khaipakh tar.
Daghan udakhe ǝn ǝntla khaya ya Yakhudi zǝ udakh ya Wurshalim a dalar da vak sar, ǝn kwarakh khaipakh tar itar. In tsuguna ka paratǝral ǝn zagh ya Urdu.
A talǝm Yukhan ad gabage a manava dǝ guj dlǝgwam, nguɗan sambal ǝn tǝ khukw tsin, dǝg zuwa sar tsuguna, tsǝvakwa zǝ yu mame ǝn tǝghal.
A kwara tǝrkhai ad lav Yazhigǝl kwarne, “Nǝg dadake da sǝgadagh ǝn tǝ tǝlg tsǝk, ai malke kǝ ndang. Ai kwal tǝkha tsǝka kǝ ɓukgan kǝ vǝda zaw kimbak sar bi.
A para kurar ka dǝ yu, in tsuguna da para kura dǝ Sǝɗikw Yazhigǝl.”
Para Yasu zǝ kura kur
Ən tǝ yanen kǝ sarta ka tsiyif Yasu sǝgadagh ǝn kǝs Nazarat ai ǝn khaya Galili, ka parandal Yukhan ǝn zagh Urdu.
Madǝv Yasu ǝn sǝgawal da tǝghay gǝrdz, ka nǝghan ad gharazhigǝl a ngurǝf, ka sodagh Sǝɗikw da tǝghǝr tsin ndǝk takalamasar.
Ka tsǝnud kwind ǝn gharazhigǝl kwarne, “Kha Zǝrar, ǝn way kha waya kǝ. Ən tsǝn zǝɗa ka char.”
Ən tǝvin tǝvina, ka ɓala Sǝɗikw da tǝghal.
Ən tǝghalena khǝna kul ufaɗ kǝ Shatan uk ǝn kura kur. Ən giɗa zǝ dǝg tǝghalakh itar ǝn vin. Ka nǝgharu Zar ɓǝlakh Yazhigǝl ǝn vin.
A farsa Yasu ad tlǝrsar ǝn Galili
Ən tǝkhal kǝ nguɗana Yukhan tsud ǝn gud sal, ka tsiyif Yasu, dal da Galili, ǝn kwardu lav Yazhigǝl ai zǝɗanyan.
Ən kwar kwarne “A sagh sart, tlǝksa Yazhigǝla a ghǝrzgan. Pǝlam pǝla ghǝr, tsuguna fadǝghǝro kuram ǝn tǝ lav zǝɗan nǝn.”
A ɗakhga Yasu ad furakh sar kǝ dǝg chak
Madǝv Yasu ǝn dǝgal ǝn tǝ kalam zagh Galili, ka nǝghan ad Siman zǝ saghǝr sar Ndros, ǝn ɗi sik vay kilf itar da dǝlv, wirva li vay kilf itar.
Ka nǝv Yasu, “Ausǝgam, gatamaks gat, da nakura kǝ li da ɗakhado udakh ka da vak Yazhigǝl.
Ən dǝvǝn dǝva, ka ɗuwars itar sika vay kilf tar, ka gatars itar.
Daga tsin da tǝvuk khǝɗikǝn, ka nǝghan ad yakhaya kǝ zarbabakh mits tsugun, Yakub zǝ Yukhan zar Zabadi ǝn peryu. Ən ɗika sik vay kilf itar.
Ən dǝvǝn dǝva ka ɗakh tǝrkhai, ka ɗuwars itar ad dad tar Zabadi ǝn peryu, zǝ zar tlǝr sar, gatars itar.
A mbanu Yasu ad dadake dǝ sǝɗikw bǝzan
Ka dagh Yasu zǝ furakh sar da Kafarnakhum. Sa kǝ fitsa ngiya ya Yakhudakh, dagh Yasu da gud dzakhava Yakhudakh. Ka farsa tsagatǝrdu tsag.
A ndawatǝrǝf tsagdu tsaga sar kǝ udakh, wirva a tsagatǝru ad lava ndǝk ude dǝ ndzǝɗ, ndǝk liye ǝn tsagdu ndzikha ndzikh bi.
A zulava bi, ka sasǝg kǝ udanen ai nguyanǝf sǝɗikw bǝzan da vak dzakhava Yakhudakh. Ka tlǝkha tsin kwarne,
“Uɗa ɗangwa tsǝkha dǝ kǝnda, Yasu ud ya Nazarati? A sa da khǝdz kǝnd khǝdza nagh kha? Tsakha tsǝka, kha Chuwaɗaɗan ai ɓǝlandagh Yazhigǝl.
Ka tavarghǝr Yasu ad di kǝ sǝɗikw bǝzan kwarne, “Tǝriɗ nǝkh, sawal sǝg ǝn vǝgh kǝ udan.”
Ka gǝɗikanǝf sǝɗikw bǝzan na dǝ yanen kǝ ud. Ka khula, sawal ǝn vǝgh tsin.

Daghan udakhe ǝn vin, a ndawatǝrǝf char. Ən ndiɗakava tsitar kwarne, “Uɗe neni? Wilwa tsagdu tsaga nagha? Udan na ǝn tsagdu tsaga dǝ ndzǝɗ. Zǝ batǝrghǝr bǝg tsin kǝ sǝɗikw bǝzanakh, kǝ tsǝnaru kǝ lav sar.
Ən dǝvǝn dǝva ka kwazga lavǝn tǝghǝr tsin, ǝn khaya Galili daghan.
A mbakhatǝru Yasu ak udakh zikǝn
Uk sawal sǝg tsitar ǝn gud dzakhava Yakhudakha, ka dagh Yasu zǝ Yakub zǝ Yukhan ger da fǝta zai Siman zǝ Ndros.
Bab nus Simana, ǝn khǝngan ǝn tuk magwǝlaɓ. Kujaɗ kujaɗa ka kwarar khai itar kǝ Yasu ad lav ǝn tǝghǝr tsin.
Ka dagh da vak sar, ka khutanan ǝn tǝ dǝv kǝ mǝlaru kǝ tsiya tsi. Tǝvin tǝvina, ka mbu ǝn tuk magwǝlaɓ, ka tatǝr khai ad dǝgway.
Kǝ khagw fitsa yanen, ɓǝldagh kǝ fatsi. Ka zaɓardǝghǝr udakh ad daghan liye kwal yang, zǝ liye ngwiyanǝf sǝɗikw bǝzan.
Ka dzafkhai udakhe ǝn khuɗ kǝs daghan ǝn tǝghay rang.
Ka mbakhatǝru Yasu kǝ udakh zikǝn, liye dǝ kuzakh sikh sikh sikh. Ka dzǝtǝrdal kǝ wurduwakh zikǝn. Ai a ɓǝlatǝrna ba dǝ kwal lava kǝ wurduwakhen bi. Wirva tsa tsitar khulfira kǝ ud Yasu.
A kwardu Yasu ad lav Yazhigǝl ǝn Galili
Pǝrta kǝdla, ǝn sarta warkhamen, ka tsiyif Yasu, ɗuwars ad mǝgh, ka dala da vake kwal nǝg kǝ itsawar, ka ɗǝgau.
Simana, zǝ liye ǝn dǝga itar dagh, a dalar da gat Yasu.
Tlarghǝr tsitara, “Udakh daghana ǝn gatkha gata” Nǝv itar tsin.
Ka ngawa tǝrkhai Yasu, “Dziyamal da tlǝrna gǝdzar kǝsakhe khef, ki da kwardu lav Yazhigǝl tsǝkǝn vin. A sodagh kǝ wirva yan kǝ.
Ka gwayafkhai ǝn khuɗ kǝ Galili daghan, ǝn kwardu lav Yazhigǝl ǝn gud dzakhava Yakhudakh, zǝ dzatǝrdu wurduwakh ǝn vǝgh kǝ udakh.
A mbanu Yasu ad ude dǝ kuza fǝch
Ka sasǝg kǝ ude dǝ kuza fǝch da vak Yasu, kǝlgan ad juguv kǝ takaɗa takaɗ, “Da khayanǝf khǝ, tǝkha kha kǝ ghuɓkay tsǝrdlak.”
Ka kwiɗ nǝv rǝv kǝ Yasu. Talala dǝ dǝv sara ka gǝman ad udanen. Ka ni, “A khayanǝf kǝ, ghuɓfǝkhay ghuɓa tsǝrdlak”
Ən dǝvǝn dǝva ka ghuɓfǝkhay tsǝrdlak ǝn tukw fǝchen.
Ka tǝkharna Yasu ad lava char, daksa niya tsin.

“Kwarara ba ak itsawar ad dǝge dzoghǝr bi. Dǝg dǝgal, mǝdlara mǝdla ghǝragh kǝ zil kǝs. Ka bǝdu kha dǝg tsufe kwarga ndzikha ndzikh Mus, wirva ghuɓe a ghuɓkhayud. Ki tsatsǝg kǝ itsawar kwarne a ghuɓkhayud.

Ai udanen tsuguna, uk dǝgal ǝn kwardu kwara tsin ad dǝge a manar khai Yasu. A ɓǝghana ba dǝ itsauɗa bi. Wirva yana, ka aghba Yasu tǝkha kǝ dagh da khuɗ kǝs ǝn di kǝ ud bi. Khalak yana ka giɗkavǝn vakakhe kwal nǝg kǝ ud. Dakhkana ka dla udakh ǝn saghgawala da vak sar itsa dǝvar.
